title: TShirtSizingEstimationInput
description: Schema to guide effort estimation using T-Shirt Sizing technique. Defines inputs and rules for mapping epics and user stories into effort buckets using size, complexity, and classification.

projectType.description: The nature or category of the system being built.

projectScale.description: Defines the size and complexity of the overall project.

timeConstraint.description: Expected duration for the project or phase.

estimatedModules.description: Number of modules (epics) to be generated. Mapped from project scale.

effortRangeHours.description: Minimum and maximum total effort across all modules in hours.

columnDefinitions.description: Structure of each output row used for estimation.

default.description: Top-level grouping or domain of related user stories.
Specific user-facing functionality or feature requirement.
Based on logic, integration, and edge cases.
Size bucket for the story, loosely representing relative effort.
Functional category. E.g., 'UI Change', 'API Integration', 'Backend Processing'.
Estimated hours required to complete the story.
Mapped based on complexity and classification.
Determined from T-Shirt size and story classification.
Effort in person-days, calculated as (Effort Hours / 8).

mappingsAndRules.description: Guidelines to translate story attributes into sizes, hours, and risks.

complexityMappingRules: Low if size is XS or S and classification is 'UI Change'
Medium if size is M and classification includes 'Integration'
High if size is L or XL or classification is 'Backend Processing'
riskMappingRules: Low if complexity is Low and classification is 'UI Change'
Medium if complexity is Medium and classification includes 'Integration'
High if complexity is High or classification is 'Backend Processing'
effortTypeMappingRules: Low if size is XS or S
High if size is L or XL

userStoryNamingRule.const: User Story should be written in the format: 'As a [user], I want to [action] so that [goal]'
